bagPolicy.summary: Country Thunder Music Festivals have implemented a clear bag policy to enhance security. Clear plastic bags up to 14” x 14”, standard one-gallon freezer bags, and small clutches and purses are allowed.
allowed: clear plastic bags up to 14” x 14”
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Concerto hasn't confirmed Country Thunder Wisconsin's parking details from an official source yet. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

rideshare.note: Uber and Lyft are available in Twin Lakes, and pre-booking your ride is recommended. Use this address for the designated rideshare zone: 40383-40001, CO HWY 0, Genoa City, WI 53128.

concessions.summary: Outside food and beverages aren't allowed in the concert bowl, except one factory-sealed plastic bottle of water. To buy or drink alcohol, get an age verification wristband at an alcohol ID tent, and keep your photo ID on you.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible parking is at the front of the reserved parking area, across from the reserved festival entrance, for vehicles with a handicap parking permit or plate. Tell front gate staff when you arrive; you'll buy day parking at the lowest price and get an ADA sticker for the top left corner of your windshield.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Country Thunder Wisconsin's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call is a box office at the front gate, and signs direct you to it as you arrive at the festival grounds.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Country Thunder Wisconsin. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
